description: Project scaffolding, shared types, protobuf definitions, documentation, and deployment configs. Sets up the monorepo structure with all configuration files, shared protocol buffer definitions for inter-service communication, shared TypeScript types, Docker Compose, Kubernetes manifests, and architecture documentation.
steps: Create root-level config files: .gitignore (comprehensive for Go/Rust/Python/Node/IDE), root README.md with full project description and architecture overview

Create /shared/proto/ with protobuf definitions: graph.proto (Node, Edge, Graph messages and GraphService RPC), asset.proto (Asset types, AssetService RPC), attack_path.proto (AttackPath, PathStep, AttackPathService RPC), common.proto (shared enums, timestamps, pagination)

Create /shared/types/ with TypeScript type definitions: index.ts, auth.ts (User, Role, Session, JWT types), asset.ts (Asset, AssetType, Criticality), graph.ts (GraphNode, GraphEdge, GraphQuery), attack-path.ts (AttackPath, PathStep, TTP), dashboard.ts (DashboardStats, Alert, Status), api.ts (ApiResponse, PaginatedResponse, ErrorResponse)
Create /shared/types/package.json and tsconfig.json for the shared types package
Create /deploy/docker-compose.yml with services: frontend, api-gateway, graph-engine, asset-service, attack-path-engine, postgres, redis

Create /deploy/kubernetes/ with: namespace.yaml, api-gateway-deployment.yaml, graph-engine-deployment.yaml, asset-service-deployment.yaml, attack-path-engine-deployment.yaml, frontend-deployment.yaml, postgres-statefulset.yaml, redis-deployment.yaml, configmap.yaml, secrets.yaml, ingress.yaml
Create /deploy/docker/ with Dockerfiles for each service: Dockerfile.frontend, Dockerfile.api-gateway, Dockerfile.graph-engine, Dockerfile.asset-service, Dockerfile.attack-path-engine
Create /docs/architecture.md with comprehensive architecture overview including system diagram (mermaid), service descriptions, communication patterns, data flow
Create /docs/api.md documenting all REST API endpoints with request/response schemas
Create /docs/development.md with local development setup guide, prerequisites, running services, testing
acceptance_criteria: All directories exist with proper structure
Protobuf files have valid proto3 syntax with proper imports and service definitions
TypeScript types compile without errors (tsconfig strict mode)
Docker Compose file references all services with proper networking
Kubernetes manifests are valid YAML with proper apiVersion, kind, metadata
verification: Verify all expected directories and files exist
Validate YAML files with python -c 'import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open(f).read())' for docker-compose and k8s manifests
Verify TypeScript types with npx tsc --noEmit if tsconfig is available
Check protobuf syntax is valid proto3
findings: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY environment has no Node.js, Go, Rust, or pyyaml available on the host. Only Python 3.9.25 with stdlib is available. Verified via JSON parsing, proto3 syntax checks, YAML structural validation (no tabs, required keys present), and file existence checks. TypeScript compilation cannot be verified without tsc on the host.
